categoryName: Dairy — milk, curd, paneer, butter, cheese, cream, flavoured & UHT milk

skuLines.line: Fresh toned milk pouch (the daily workhorse)
skuLines.examples: Amul Taaza, Mother Dairy Toned, Verka Standard, HP Milkfed 'Him'
skuLines.seasonality: Year-round; volume collapses during school/university vacations and rises Nov-Feb (hot milk, tea)
skuLines.notes: 2-3 day shelf life, FSSAI 2-8°C logged chain. Highest-volume, lowest-margin line in the store — it exists to pull footfall, not profit. Verka hiked ₹2/L in May 2026 (₹65 standard, Shimla belt); HP Milkfed cut ₹3-4/L post-GST. Needs a DG-backed cold room; one power cut writes off the day's pouches.

skuLines.examples: Amul Gold, Mother Dairy Full Cream, Verka Full Fat, Nandini Gold
skuLines.seasonality: Peaks in hill winter (Dec-Feb) and at festivals (kheer, karah prasad, mithai)
skuLines.notes: Punjabi households buy full cream, not toned — for dahi setting, malai, kheer and chai. Same 2-8°C constraint.

skuLines.examples: Amul Cow Milk, HP Milkfed 'Him Gauri', Mother Dairy Cow Milk
skuLines.notes: Him Gauri at ₹55/L is the locally-procured HP Milkfed line — shortest haul into Rajgarh, so the least monsoon-exposed fresh-milk SKU. Preferred for toddlers and the elderly over buffalo/full cream.

skuLines.examples: Amul Slim n Trim, Mother Dairy Double Toned, Nestlé a+ Slim
skuLines.notes: Diabetic/BP staff and elderly residents. One facing is enough — do not over-index; it cannibalises toned rather than adding volume.

skuLines.line: Buffalo / high-fat standardised milk (for dahi, paneer, kheer)
skuLines.examples: Amul Shakti, local buffalo milk, Verka Standardised
skuLines.seasonality: Festival and langar spikes (Gurpurab, Lohri, Baisakhi, Bandi Chhor)
skuLines.notes: FSSAI minimum 6% fat / 8.5% SNF for buffalo. This is the milk that home dahi and langar kheer actually need; toned milk sets a thin curd and families notice.

skuLines.line: Loose / raw milk counter from local Baru Sahib & Rajgarh producers
skuLines.examples: Local cattle-rearer supply, HP Milkfed loose cow milk (₹51/L, 2026)
skuLines.seasonality: Cheapest and most abundant in the Oct-Mar flush; thin and dearer in the Apr-Jun lean season
skuLines.notes: Best margin in the whole category and shortest supply line, but the heaviest compliance: FSSAI needs source declaration (farm name + location), fat ≥3.5% cow / ≥6% buffalo, SNF ≥8.5%, food-grade steel cans (no aluminium), annual medical-fitness certificates for handlers, and a logged 2-8°C chain. A lactometer + fat kit at the counter is not optional.

skuLines.line: UHT tetra toned milk — the shelf-stable monsoon buffer
skuLines.examples: Amul Taaza tetra, Nandini tetra, Nestlé a+, Mother Dairy UHT
skuLines.seasonality: Stock deepest Jul-Sep (monsoon road cuts) and before every long weekend/vacation return
skuLines.notes: 180-day shelf life, no refrigeration until opened — the single most important line for a 30-50 km hill road. GST went 5%→NIL on 22-Sep-2025, so it is now price-competitive with pouch milk (UHT normally carries an ₹8-12/L processing premium). Carry 7-10 days of campus consumption as a landslide buffer; ICAR puts pre-consumer milk spoilage at 6-8% nationally and only ~30-35% of tier-2/3 outlets have reliable refrigeration.

skuLines.examples: Amul Gold tetra, Nestlé a+ Grade A, Pride of Cows
skuLines.notes: Case-pack sale to staff quarters is the easy win — one 6-pack replaces a week of fridge risk. Ambient stacking frees cold-room space.

skuLines.line: Single-serve plain fortified milk for children (200 ml)
skuLines.examples: Nestlé a+ 200 ml, Amul Taaza 200 ml tetra, Mother Dairy 200 ml
skuLines.notes: Ambient, no fridge, no glass — the right format for a 5-18 residential school and for hostel-room stock. Vitamin A&D fortified variants sell better to parents.

skuLines.examples: Sid's Farm A2, Akshayakalpa Organic, local Sahiwal/Gir A2
skuLines.notes: A2/lactose-free milk is forecast to grow ~17.8%/yr 2026-2036. Only worth a facing if a local desi-cow supply exists — branded A2 hauled up the hill will not clear at ₹120/L. Cold chain same as fresh milk.

skuLines.examples: Amul Lactose Free Milk, Epigamia lactose-free, Nestlé a+ Lactose Free
skuLines.notes: Small absolute demand but zero substitutes within 30-50 km — for the handful of lactose-intolerant students and staff this is a medical need, not a preference. UHT format means one case can sit on the shelf without loss.

skuLines.line: Institutional bulk milk for the two canteens, mess & langar
skuLines.examples: 500 ml pouch crates (40-50/crate), 1 L pouches by the case, 20-40 L chilled cans
skuLines.seasonality: Follows the academic calendar exactly — indent must drop to near-zero on vacation days or it spoils
skuLines.notes: The largest single dairy volume on campus: chai and hot milk for ~5,000 people. Run it as a standing weekly indent, not counter sales. Needs its own chilled receiving point and a written vacation calendar in the buying plan.

skuLines.examples: Amul Masti Dahi, Mother Dairy Classic Dahi, Verka Dahi, Milky Mist Curd
skuLines.seasonality: Peaks Apr-Jun; drops sharply in hill winter
skuLines.notes: 5-7 day shelf life at 2-8°C. North-Indian plate staple — a dahi stockout is felt faster than any other dairy gap. Do not over-order into a vacation week.

skuLines.examples: Amul Masti 1 kg, Mother Dairy 1 kg pouch, Milky Mist 1 kg
skuLines.notes: Wholesale reference ~₹80/kg (Amul Masti 1 kg). Married-staff quarters buy the kilo, not the cup.

skuLines.line: Bulk dahi bucket / matka for canteens
skuLines.examples: Amul Masti Curd 5 kg bucket, Ananda Dahi Matka 5 kg, Milky Mist 5 kg, Amul Lite Dahi Matka 15 kg
skuLines.seasonality: Apr-Jun peak (raita, lassi, chaach at mess); low Dec-Feb
skuLines.notes: Verified wholesale: Amul Masti 5 kg ~₹58/kg, Ananda matka 5 kg ₹355.95, Milky Mist 5 kg ₹491.40. Buckets are returnable/reusable — worth a deposit system. 5-7 day life means the indent must track the mess menu, not the month.

skuLines.examples: Mother Dairy b-Activ Probiotic Dahi, Nestlé a+ Dahi, Amul Probiotic Dahi
skuLines.notes: Sells to staff and elderly on gut-health grounds; needs the coldest shelf (live cultures) and honest date rotation.

skuLines.examples: Epigamia Natural Greek Yogurt, Milky Mist Greek Yogurt, Amul High Protein Yogurt
skuLines.notes: The premium end that actually earns money: 34% of Indian consumers now actively seek high-protein options. Epigamia 400 g runs ~₹250 while Milky Mist is roughly half the per-100 g price — stock the value brand deep and the premium one shallow. 15-21 day shelf life, strict cold chain.

skuLines.examples: Epigamia (mango, strawberry, blueberry), Milky Mist Fruit Yogurt, Nestlé Fruit Yogurt
skuLines.notes: The impulse chiller SKU for school and university students — but it is a dead facing in vacations. Multipacks move better to staff families.

skuLines.line: Kids' single-serve dahi / mini yogurt (80-100 g)
skuLines.examples: Mother Dairy Mishti Doi 85 g, Amul Masti 100 g, Milky Mist mini cups
skuLines.notes: Right portion for a hostel tiffin and for babies/toddlers in staff quarters; no leftovers, no fridge needed for an hour.

skuLines.examples: Mother Dairy Misti Doi 400 g, Milky Mist Mishti Doi, Amul Mishti Doi
skuLines.notes: Sells as a dessert, not as dairy — merchandise it next to sweets, not next to plain dahi.

skuLines.examples: Amul Shrikhand (elaichi, kesar, mango), Milky Mist Shrikhand, Vadilal Shrikhand
skuLines.seasonality: Heavy spike at Gurpurab, Baisakhi, Lohri, Diwali/Bandi Chhor and school function days
skuLines.notes: Chilled, 20-30 day life. Order against the campus event calendar — this line is entirely occasion-driven, and a festival stockout is a wallet that leaves for town.

skuLines.examples: Haldiram's & Bikano Rasgulla/Gulab Jamun tins, Amul Rabri, Milky Mist Payasam, Vadilal Basundi
skuLines.notes: Ambient and long-life — the safest festival dairy bet in a place where fresh mithai cannot be hauled in reliably. Vegetarian mark essential.

skuLines.examples: Amul Masti Spiced Buttermilk, Mother Dairy Pudina Chaach, Verka Chaach, Milky Mist Buttermilk
skuLines.notes: ₹10 price point makes it the highest-frequency dairy impulse buy for students. Mother Dairy Tadka Chaach 270 ml at ₹10 is the volume driver. Chilled, 5-10 day life.

skuLines.examples: Amul Lassi (sweet, rose, kesar), Mother Dairy Lassi, Verka Lassi, Milky Mist Lassi
skuLines.notes: Punjabi staple — lassi outsells cola in this cohort during summer. 1 L pack for families, 200 ml for the canteen counter.

skuLines.examples: Amul High Protein Lassi / Buttermilk, Epigamia Protein Shake, Amul Protein Milk
skuLines.notes: Amul's protein-enriched milk volumes rose 34% in FY25 — this is the fastest-growing premium dairy shelf in India and lands squarely on 18-25 university students. Tetra variants are ambient, which suits the hill haul.

skuLines.line: Flavoured milk — chocolate, badam, rose, kesar, elaichi
skuLines.examples: Amul Kool (Kesar, Badam, Chocolate), Cavin's, Hershey's Milkshake, Mother Dairy Flavoured Milk
skuLines.notes: India's fastest-growing dairy line: ₹76.4 bn in 2025, ~15-21% CAGR, +38% consumption 2020-2024 (NDDB); Amul is doubling flavoured-milk capacity by 2026. Chocolate is the #1 flavour. Retort cans and tetra are ambient and unbreakable — the right formats for a hostel and a hill road; avoid glass.

skuLines.examples: Amul Kool Cafe, Cavin's Milkshake (Badam, Rajbog, Rabri), Nescafé RTD, Amul Kool Milk Shake
skuLines.notes: CavinKare moved its badam/gulkhand/rajbog milkshakes into retort aluminium cans (with Ball) in 2024 — ambient, 6-9 month life, no cold chain. Ideal for the Ary Lite counter.

skuLines.examples: Yakult, Mother Dairy Nutrifit, Amul Prolife
skuLines.notes: Must stay at 2-8°C throughout or the cultures die — only stock if the cold room is DG-backed. Sells to staff families with small children.

skuLines.examples: Amul Malai/Fresh Paneer, Mother Dairy Paneer, Milky Mist Paneer, Verka Paneer
skuLines.seasonality: Year-round; heavy festival and function spikes
skuLines.notes: The single most important protein SKU on a vegetarian Sikh campus — paneer is the 'meat' of the plate here. GST on pre-packaged paneer went 5%→NIL on 22-Sep-2025, so MRPs were cut. FSSAI: full-fat paneer ≥50% fat on dry basis, store and transport below 4°C. Fresh life is only 5-7 days — this line breaks first when the road closes.

skuLines.line: Bulk paneer 1 kg for canteens, mess & langar
skuLines.examples: Milky Mist Paneer 1 kg, Amul Paneer 1 kg, Verka bulk paneer
skuLines.notes: Verified wholesale: Milky Mist 1 kg ₹384; Delhi retail ran ₹373-375/kg in Aug 2026. Buy on indent against the mess menu; below 4°C, and never break the block for retail once it has been opened.

skuLines.line: Long-life / frozen / vacuum-packed paneer (the road-cut insurance)
skuLines.examples: Milky Mist vacuum-packed paneer, frozen paneer cubes, Amul frozen paneer
skuLines.notes: 30-90 day shelf life vacuum-packed, longer frozen. Needs a deep freezer (-18°C), not just a chiller. This is the only way to keep protein on the shelf through a monsoon landslide week — worth the freezer on its own.

skuLines.examples: Milky Mist Smart Chef Paneer Tikka & Paneer Crunchies, Amul paneer cubes, marinated paneer
skuLines.notes: Frozen; only viable with a working deep freezer. Sells to the canteens as a labour-saver more than to households.

skuLines.examples: Nutrela Tofu, Urban Platter Tofu, local soy paneer
skuLines.notes: The substitute for lactose-intolerant and vegan residents, and a hedge when paneer supply breaks. Chilled, 15-30 day life. Rising lactose-intolerance awareness is pushing plant-based into the same chiller.

skuLines.examples: Amul Butter, Mother Dairy Butter, Verka Butter, Nandini Butter
skuLines.notes: GST cut 12%→5% on 22-Sep-2025 and Amul/Mother Dairy/Nandini passed it through — check that old higher-MRP stock is not still on the shelf. Wholesale reference ₹304.50 for 500 g salted. Chilled but forgiving; 4-6 month life sealed.

skuLines.examples: Amul Unsalted Butter 500 g, local desi makhan, Verka White Butter
skuLines.seasonality: Peaks in winter and at Lohri/Baisakhi; loose makhan sells best in the Oct-Mar flush
skuLines.notes: Punjabi kitchens want makhan, not salted butter — for makki-di-roti, parathas and langar. Wholesale reference ₹289.80 for 500 g unsalted. Loose makhan from local milk is a genuine margin line if the cold chain holds.

skuLines.line: Butter portion packs / chiplets for mess & canteen
skuLines.examples: Amul Butter chiplets 8.2 g / 10 g, Mother Dairy portion packs
skuLines.notes: Portion control for two canteens feeding thousands — stops the pilferage and waste that a 500 g block invites. Ambient-tolerant for short periods, which suits a serving counter.

skuLines.line: Fat spread / margarine / low-fat table spread
skuLines.examples: Amul Lite, Nutralite, Amul Margarine, Nutralite Professional Fat Spread
skuLines.notes: Not technically dairy but lives in the same chiller and buys off the same vendor. Wholesale ₹94.50-96.60 per 500 g. Cheaper per kg than butter for canteen bulk baking and grilling; longer life than butter.

skuLines.examples: Amul Cheese Block 200 g/1 kg, Amul Cheese Cubes, Go Cheese, Britannia Cheese Block
skuLines.packSizes: 200 g, 400 g, 1 kg block; 200 g cubes
skuLines.notes: Processed blocks and slices lead India's cheese market; Amul holds ~40-45% share. Wholesale reference ₹540.75 for a 1 kg block. GST 12%→5%. CRITICAL for a Sikh institution: verify the green vegetarian mark / microbial (non-animal) rennet on every cheese SKU — some imported cheeses use animal rennet and cannot be on this shelf.

skuLines.examples: Amul Cheese Slices 10s, Britannia Slices, Go Cheese Slices, institutional 750 g / 50-slice
skuLines.notes: The canteen sandwich/burger workhorse. Wholesale reference ₹421.05 for 750 g / 50 slices. Buy the institutional pack for canteens and the 10s for households — don't try to serve both from one SKU.

skuLines.examples: Amul Pizza Mozzarella, Amul Diced Mozzarella 1 kg, Go Mozzarella, Milky Mist Mozzarella
skuLines.notes: Mozzarella is ~35% of India's cheese market and the cheese category is compounding at ~19%/yr — pizza and pasta at the canteens are what pull it. Wholesale ₹493.50 for 1 kg diced. Freezes well (unlike most dairy), so it is a safe deep-freezer buffer line.

skuLines.examples: Amul Cheese Spread (plain, pepper, garlic), The Laughing Cow, Britannia Cheese Spread
skuLines.notes: Britannia-Bel's ₹220 cr Ranjangaon plant now makes The Laughing Cow in India, so supply and price have improved. Spreads are the third-largest cheese format after blocks/slices and mozzarella.

skuLines.line: Cheese sauce / nacho cheese for canteen
skuLines.examples: Amul Cheese Sauce, D'lecta Cheese Sauce, Cremica cheese dip
skuLines.notes: Ambient until opened — a canteen-only line. Sells the canteen a menu (nachos, pasta, cheese fries) rather than an ingredient.

skuLines.examples: Amul Emmental/Gouda, D'lecta Cream Cheese, cheddar, parmesan, feta, Flanders/Eleftheria
skuLines.notes: Two or three facings maximum — this is a staff/faculty and bakery line, not a campus line. Wholesale D'lecta cream cheese 1 kg ₹696.15. Every SKU must carry the vegetarian mark; slow-moving stock at ₹400 a wedge is real money dead on a hill shelf.

skuLines.examples: Amul Fresh Cream, Milky Mist Fresh Cream, Madhusudan Fresh Cream, Nestlé Milkmaid Cream
skuLines.seasonality: Festival cooking and winter (gravies, kheer, halwa)
skuLines.notes: Tetra cream is ambient until opened — much easier on the hill than chilled cream. Wholesale ₹247 (Amul 1 L), ₹230 (Madhusudan 1 L tetra).

skuLines.line: Whipping cream / non-dairy whip topping (bakery & birthday cakes)
skuLines.examples: Rich's Double Dream 1 L, Tropolite Whipping Cream, D'lecta Whip Topping, Amul Whipping Cream
skuLines.seasonality: Birthdays year-round; heavy at term-start, farewells and function weeks
skuLines.notes: Wholesale reference: Rich's Double Dream 1 L ₹186.90. Non-dairy whip is frozen-stable and forgiving of a broken cold chain — the practical choice here over dairy whipping cream. 5,000 residents means birthday cakes every single week.

skuLines.examples: Local malai, Milky Mist Khova, mawa from Rajgarh halwais
skuLines.seasonality: Very heavy spikes at Gurpurab, Diwali/Bandi Chhor, Lohri, Baisakhi and Holi (burfi, gulab jamun, pinni, panjiri)
skuLines.notes: Highest-margin dairy line and the one most likely to leak off-campus if missing — a family that drives 30-50 km for festival mawa spends the rest of that trip in town too. Very short life (2-4 days chilled); buy to a pre-order sheet against the festival calendar, never to stock.

skuLines.examples: Nestlé Milkmaid 380-400 g, Amul Mithaimate, Milky Mist Sweet Condensed Milk 395 g
skuLines.notes: Ambient, 12-15 month shelf life — a festival dairy line with no cold-chain risk at all. Stock ahead of Diwali/Gurpurab; it also rescues dessert-making when khoya and fresh cream cannot be hauled in.

skuLines.examples: Nestlé Everyday, Amulya Dairy Whitener, Sagar Tea & Coffee Whitener
skuLines.packSizes: 200 g, 400 g, 1 kg pouch; 8 g sachets
skuLines.seasonality: Deepest stock Jul-Sep and Dec-Feb (chai season)
skuLines.notes: The ambient insurance policy for 5,000 people's tea. Verified: Amulya ₹255 and Nestlé Everyday ₹255 on q-commerce; institutional 1 kg pouches available wholesale. 6-9 month shelf life, no fridge, stacks anywhere — when the Rajgarh road closes this is what keeps the canteens and hostels serving chai.

skuLines.examples: Amul Sagar Skimmed Milk Powder, Nestlé Everyday Full Cream, Amul Full Cream Milk Powder
skuLines.packSizes: 500 g, 1 kg pouch; 25 kg institutional bag
skuLines.seasonality: Monsoon buffer; winter sweets and langar kheer
skuLines.notes: Reconstitutes to milk for the canteens at a lower landed cost per litre than hauled fresh milk, and never spoils in transit. The institutional bag is worth negotiating for the mess and langar kitchen.

skuLines.line: Toddler growing-up milk powder (1-3 yr, stage 3/4)
skuLines.examples: Amulspray, Nestlé Nan Grow, Lactogen 3/4, Enfamil Junior
skuLines.notes: Married-staff quarters have babies and toddlers and no market within 30-50 km — a stockout here is a family emergency, not a lost sale. LICENCE CONSTRAINT: the Infant Milk Substitutes, Feeding Bottles and Infant Foods Act 1992 (strengthened 2003) bans all promotion of foods marketed for children up to two years — no display promotion, no offers or discount signage, no free samples, no shelf-talkers. Selling it is legal; advertising it is a criminal offence. Ambient, 12-18 month life.

skuLines.examples: Nestlé Nan Pro 1/2, Lactogen 1/2, Dexolac, Similac Advance
skuLines.notes: Carry a minimum standing stock of the two or three brands actually used on campus and keep it behind the counter, sold on request only — same IMS Act 1992 ban on any promotion, display offer or sample, criminal liability attached. Thin margin, non-negotiable stocking: the alternative is a parent on a hill road at night.

skuLines.examples: Amul Pure Ghee, Verka Desi Ghee, HP Milkfed 'Him' Ghee, Patanjali Cow Ghee
skuLines.packSizes: 200 ml, 500 ml, 1 L pouch/jar/tin; 5 L & 15 L tin
skuLines.seasonality: Winter and festival peaks (pinni, panjiri, halwa, karah prasad)
skuLines.notes: Flag: ghee may already sit in the edible-oils & ghee lane — listed here for completeness so it is not lost between the two. GST 12%→5% on 22-Sep-2025. Ambient, 9-12 month life. The 5 L / 15 L tin is a langar and canteen line and one of the largest single dairy spends on a Sikh campus (karah prasad is pure ghee).

trends2026: GST 2.0 reset the whole dairy price ladder (effective 22-Sep-2025): UHT milk and pre-packaged/labelled paneer went 5% → NIL, and butter, ghee, cheese and dairy spreads went 12% → 5%. Amul, Mother Dairy and Nandini cut MRPs accordingly, and HP Milkfed passed it through as a ₹3-4/L retail cut. Any pre-Sep-2025 MRP stock on a shelf, or any buying sheet still using old rates, is now wrong.

High-protein is the growth engine of Indian dairy, not a metro fad: 34% of consumers actively seek high-protein options and Amul's protein-enriched milk volumes jumped 34% in FY25. Protein lassi, protein buttermilk, high-protein paneer and Greek yogurt are now mainstream SKUs — and this maps directly onto an 18-25 university cohort.

Greek/strained yogurt is scaling down-market. Epigamia pioneered the category at ~₹250 per 400 g / ₹60 per 100 g; Milky Mist now sells comparable yogurt at roughly half the per-100 g price (~₹30/100 g), and Parag's Pride of Cows pushed no-added-sugar Greek variants. Yogurt is forecast at ~8% CAGR to 2031 while milk still holds ~62% of the dairy market.

Flavoured milk is the fastest-growing dairy line in India: ₹76.4 bn in 2025, forecast 15-21% CAGR, +38% consumption between 2020 and 2024 (NDDB), chocolate the leading flavour, and Amul doubling its flavoured-milk capacity by 2026. Packaging is shifting to retort aluminium cans and tetra (CavinKare with Ball, 2024) — ambient, unbreakable, ideal for hostels and hill roads.

Cheese is compounding at ~19% a year (₹128.9 bn in 2025 → ₹619.9 bn by 2034) with mozzarella at ~35% share, pulled by pizza/pasta in institutional and canteen kitchens. Amul holds ~40-45%; Britannia-Bel's ₹220 cr Ranjangaon plant localised The Laughing Cow; India's mozzarella exports rose over 1,200% in Apr-Sep 2025.

A2 and lactose-free move from niche to a stocked line — A2/lactose-free milk projected at ~17.8% CAGR from 2026 to 2036 off a $0.88 bn 2025 base — with plant-based yogurt and tofu entering the same chiller on lactose-intolerance and flexitarian demand.

Ambient dairy as cold-chain insurance is now economically obvious. ICAR puts pre-consumer milk spoilage at 6-8% (USD 1.8-2.4 bn); only ~30-35% of tier-2/3 outlets have reliable refrigeration and fresh-chain spoilage there runs 8-12% vs 2-4% in mature markets. UHT costs ₹8-12/L more to make but is 180-day shelf-stable — and with UHT now at NIL GST that premium has largely closed.

FSSAI is tightening dairy retail through 2026: a national advisory pushing mandatory registration for milk sellers and vendors, source declaration for loose milk, food-grade steel (not aluminium) containers, annual medical-fitness certificates for handlers, logged 2-8°C storage and transit with documented corrective action on any excursion, and a nationwide crackdown on adulterated milk and dairy.
adjacentServices: Household milk & curd subscription with a morning doorstep drop inside the township (staff-family quarters, faculty housing). Dairy is the only genuinely daily-repeat category on campus, so it is the natural anchor for a prepaid subscription book — and it converts an ₹1,493/month resident into a predictable, non-negotiable line item.

Standing bulk supply contract plus a weekly indent sheet for the two canteens, the hostel mess and the Gurdwara langar: milk crates, 5 kg dahi buckets, 1 kg paneer, mozzarella, cheese slices, butter chiplets, whitener and ghee tins, delivered from the warehouse instead of sold over the counter.

An on-campus paneer and dahi make-shop: set curd and press paneer from bulk/local milk. It turns 3-6% pouch-milk margin into 20-35% fresh-product margin, and it is the only real answer to a monsoon road cut taking out the protein shelf.

Cold-room and deep-freezer capacity as a service: chilled locker space for hostel wardens, the fruits-and-vegetables counter and staff, plus a -18°C freezer holding the frozen-paneer and mozzarella buffer. Must be DG-backed — every probiotic, curd and fresh-paneer SKU dies in one long power cut.

A chai / cold-coffee / lassi counter at Ary Lite drawing on the store's own whitener, milk and flavoured-milk stock — the highest-frequency footfall driver available, and it monetises whitener and near-date milk instead of writing it off.

Festival and function pre-order desk against the campus calendar (Gurpurab, Lohri, Baisakhi, Bandi Chhor, Holi, parents' days, farewells): khoya, mawa, paneer for langar, whipping cream and condensed milk, ghee tins. Short-life, high-margin items bought to an order sheet rather than to stock.
Weekly birthday-cake service for a 5,000-person residential campus, built off whipping cream, butter, cream cheese and condensed milk already on the shelf.

Returnable-crate and bucket deposit system (milk crates, 5/15 kg dahi matkas) plus pouch collection — cuts packaging cost, keeps the vendor's assets accounted for, and gives the store a reverse-logistics load on the same truck.
Prepaid student tuck card for flavoured milk, curd cups and buttermilk, settled with parents monthly — captures the impulse spend that otherwise waits for a trip to town.
